title: ci: Spec Main Shape Gate leaves the required set — advisory on PRs, hourly on main; the required-check pin declares the seven ruled names (objectui#12240)
body:
Fixes #12240
Clause-②: no

`Spec Main Shape Gate` leaves the merge queue's required set on the maintainer's ruling B (objectui#12214, ACCEPT 6123370050, open question 1 answered B, filed as objectui#12240). It keeps running and keeps posting its verdict; nothing it verifies changes (the bypass, the anti-false-green marker with the injected sha and time, the attribution). This pull request moves every in-tree declaration of the required set. The ruleset edit itself is the maintainer's act.

## The required names, before and after

**Before** (live, read 2026-10-12 with `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main`, ruleset 11776024, in the endpoint's order):
`Lint` · `Type Check` · `Build & E2E` · `Build Docs` · `Changeset Declaration` · `Test` · `Spec Main Shape Gate` · `Governed Surface Queue Guard`

**After** the maintainer's edit (the same list minus one, order kept):
`Lint` · `Type Check` · `Build & E2E` · `Build Docs` · `Changeset Declaration` · `Test` · `Governed Surface Queue Guard`

The "after" list is byte-identical to the seven names `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` now declares (`PINNED_CONTEXTS` = `Type Check`, `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` = the other six) and to the committed control fixture `ruling-12240.json`.

## The maintainer's act, in the same sitting as the merge

Settings → Rules → Rulesets → ruleset 11776024 (`main`) → "Require status checks to pass" → remove `Spec Main Shape Gate`. Nothing else in the ruleset changes.

Either order is safe, because `spec-main-shape-gate.yml` keeps its `merge_group` trigger (see the trigger decision below). One case forces "edit first": if `Spec Main Shape Gate` happens to be red when this pull request is enqueued (objectstack drift), its own queue build is still gated by the context until the edit.

## What `required-check-set-patrol` reads in between: GREEN, not red

Read from `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`, not assumed: a required context the pin does not declare makes the verdict `drifted`; `exitCodeFor('drifted')` is 0; the patrol's "Fail the run" step runs only on a non-zero exit. Measured with this branch's script over the live answer:

- **Merged, edit not yet made** (live = 8 names): `DRIFTED — every pinned context present; 0 watched missing, 1 undeclared (8 required context(s) read)`, summary line "Required but not declared here: `Spec Main Shape Gate`.", exit 0. Pinned by the test on the dated verbatim reading `live-2026-10-12.json`.
- **After the edit** (the `ruling-12240.json` fixture): `INTACT — 1 pinned and 6 watched context(s) all present (7 required context(s) read)`, exit 0.
- **Today on `main`, before this PR:** the same live answer already reads DRIFTED, naming `Governed Surface Queue Guard` as required but not declared (enrolled under objectui#6596, never added to the pin). This PR declares it, as the ruling's seven names include it.
- **Edit made before the merge:** `main`'s old pin reads DRIFTED naming both halves, exit 0.

The patrol cannot go red from this change in any order: its one pinned name, `Type Check`, is untouched.

## The trigger decision: `merge_group` stays (H2 refuted on sequencing)

The PM's suggestion was to drop `merge_group`. Kept, deliberately; the workflow header now says why.

- **Sequencing.** The ruled order is merge first, ruleset edit second, and this pull request itself lands through the queue. A merge group runs the workflow file of its own head, so with the trigger dropped this PR's queue build, and every entry built on top of it (`max_entries_to_build: 5`), would never report a context the ruleset still requires and would wait out `check_response_timeout_minutes: 60` and fail: objectui#3523's shape, on the way out. Keeping it makes this PR order-independent.
- **Pin.** `scripts/__tests__/spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts` › "subscribes merge_group, so a maintainer can enrol it without stalling the queue" reds on the drop. Measured: an ablation deleting the two trigger lines ran the five affected test files at 1 failed / 211 passed (that test only), restored to the HEAD blob. `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts`'s derived `merge_group` floor stops covering this workflow once the Dependabot gate classifies the name `NOT_A_GATE` (below), so that pin does not bind.
- **Cost of keeping it**, from the Actions API: the newest 100 completed `merge_group` runs of this workflow (2026-10-09T12:50Z to 2026-10-12T12:17Z; `total_count` 1255) are about 33.6 runs a day at a 13.1-minute median wall, about 440 runner-minutes a day; public repository, not billed. After the edit those runs gate nothing and do not lengthen a queue entry (the queue waits only on required contexts); they occupy runner slots. For scale, `pull_request` runs: 100 in the newest 1.08 days, 12.1-minute median.
- **Proposed, not taken here:** once the patrol reads INTACT on seven, a one-line follow-up drops `merge_group` and rewords that pin to "re-subscribe before re-enrolling". The report carries it as an open question.

## H1: partly refuted, there was a second blocking mechanism in the tree

Whether a check blocks the queue is the ruleset's property, so the workflow needs no mechanism: no `continue-on-error` (it would hide the verdict), and no placeholder or plumbing step exists in the file. The concurrency rule that never cancels a queue build exists for the required role and is not dead while `merge_group` is subscribed; left as is. But `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` declared the name in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, so the Dependabot auto-merge gate waited for the check and refused a red: a pull-request-side block the ruleset edit would not remove, and the line the workflow header itself called the in-tree half of the enrolment. It moves to `NOT_A_GATE` with its reason; the test pins the move by name with a control (the same red on `Type Check` still refuses). Window note: between merge and edit the Dependabot gate no longer waits for it while the queue still does; a red there is caught by the queue build.

## H3: confirmed

The hourly `schedule` (`cron: '48 * * * *'`) is in `spec-main-shape-gate.yml` itself (PR #12232, `21fdeb34`). This card owns no line of `ci.yml` and touches none. NOT MEASURED: the first scheduled run (PR #12232 merged 12:10Z; at 12:55Z the Actions API listed no `schedule` run of this workflow yet).

## H4: every enumeration moved, and the grep

`git grep -n 'Spec Main Shape Gate'` on `main` (`923504f4`): 52 hits in 32 files.

Moved (enumerations of, or claims about, the required set):
- `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`: the header section that said the context was "NOT required yet" is replaced by the advisory posture, the main-red rule and the `merge_group` reasoning. Comment-only: the parsed YAML is identical to `main`'s.
- `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`: the pin (tombstone naming this card and ACCEPT 6123370050's answer B; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` declared).
- `scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` and its fixtures: new dated live reading `live-2026-10-12.json`, new control `ruling-12240.json`, `type-check-removed.json` regenerated from the new control; `ruling-9499.json` and `ruling-9969.json` retired (read by nothing else).
- `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` and its test: `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` to `NOT_A_GATE`.
- `.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml`: its header's present-tense list of required names is dated to the fold (comment-only).
- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: the inventory row, the gate's section, the fold paragraph; `scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`: the two command-parity reasons for that section re-worded (keys unchanged).

Count enumerations without the name, moved: `required-check-set-patrol.yml` ("requires nine check contexts", "the eight WATCHED contexts"), the guide's patrol section ("the other eight", "the nine"), and the script header's present-tense "currently holds nine contexts". Each now points at the script instead of carrying a number (AGENTS.md #9). No script or test reads any of these counts, so nothing was loosened to "at least".

Left, because they are not enumerations of the required set: three pending changesets (11573, 12093, 12170) and three published CHANGELOG entries describe the gate as a compile target; 21 hits in 16 files under `packages/` name it as the compile against objectstack `main`; `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` prints it as a summary heading. None says the context is required. `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` carry no enumeration of the set.

## Gates, on head `22124378`

objectstack's `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` refuses by design (it derives only from an objectstack checkout), so the list is hand-derived from this repository's `package.json` and workflows:

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/ eslint-rules/`: 191 files passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed, 5778 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 1). The one failure is `dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` timing out at 15 s with the import phase at 344 s on a shared box; it reads none of the changed files and passes alone (37/37, 8.1 s).
- The six core files (`check-required-check-set`, `dependabot-merge-gate`, `merge-queue-reporting`, `spec-main-shape-gate`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `check-merge-queue-head`): 252/252.
- `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs --self-test`: 32 cases pass, exit 0. Live: node's fetch answers 401 through the agent proxy (as on objectui#12214), so the live answer was taken with `gh` and fed through `--fixture`: DRIFTED, exit 0, as above.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: exit 0 (`--listFilesOnly` includes the three edited test files).
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the five changed `.mjs`/`.ts` files: 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The narrowing is proven: population from `eslint.config.js` (flat-config default `js`/`mjs` plus `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`; no ignore covers `scripts/`); count from the JSON output; no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` (type-aware linting off) and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0 each: `check-governed-queue-guard --self-test` (and `--test` over the 12 paths: NOT GOVERNED), `check-merge-queue-head --self-test`, `check-changeset-presence` (no changeset owed), `check-control-bytes`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-action-ref-convention`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-test-path-roots`.
- YAML parse of the three touched workflows: ok, and each parses identical to `main`'s. `actionlint`: NOT MEASURED (not installed).

**Ablations** (committed first, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with its trap and blob proof):
1. `Spec Main Shape Gate` re-added to `WATCHED_CONTEXTS`: 6 failed / 25 passed in `check-required-check-set.test.ts`; restored to blob `76373853`.
2. `Spec Main Shape Gate` put back in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`: 4 failed (the new block and the partition test) / 53 passed across `dependabot-merge-gate` and `merge-queue-reporting`; restored to blob `21f065a2`.
3. The `merge_group` counterfactual above: 1 failed / 211 passed; restored to blob `ba27aba4`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance (three consecutive PRs with every required check green inside the `Type Check` bound; the gate visible as non-required; the hourly run carrying it) is measurable only after the maintainer's edit and the first scheduled runs.
- The workflow's `concurrency` and `timeout-minutes` comments still reason about queue builds; true while `merge_group` is subscribed and the context is required, moot for an advisory check afterwards. Left untouched (`timeout-minutes` is out of this card's scope); a `merge_group` follow-up would be their carrier.
- `.github/workflows/**` is called Tier H in the claim; `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` answers NOT GOVERNED for all 12 paths. The PR stays a draft either way: it is a dispatched PR.
- No changeset: CI, docs and tests only (`check-changeset-presence` exit 0).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`Spec Main Shape Gate`(用 objectstack `main` 现编出的 spec 编译本仓)从合并队列的必过检查里拿掉。它照样在每个 PR 上跑、照样给出结论,只是不再挡合并;每小时在 `main` 上跑一次,作为完整测试的一部分。仓内所有"必过检查清单"的记录一起改成新的七项,Dependabot 自动合并也不再等它。它检查的内容一个字没动。

**为什么改**:你在 objectui#12214 的问题 1 上选了 B(「我接受你的建议」)。这个检查是每个 PR 最慢的一环(约 13 分钟),而且它红的时候多数是 objectstack 那边在变,不是这个 PR 的错。拿掉之后,PR 的等待时间降到 `Type Check` 那一档。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:一个 objectstack 改坏 objectui 编译的变化,不再在 PR 上被拦住,而是在下一次整点运行时在 `main` 上变红;那时按两档 CI 的规则算作 devx 这条线的 main-red,下一个 PR 先修它。巡检(`required-check-set-patrol`)在合并和你改规则之间读作"有漂移",但不会变红。回滚:在规则集里把这个检查加回去,并还原本 PR 的三个提交;工作流仍订阅合并队列,所以加回去不会卡住队列。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:批准并合并本 PR;同一次操作里到 Settings → Rules → Rulesets → 11776024(`main`)→ 必过状态检查,删掉 `Spec Main Shape Gate`,剩下七项保持不动。先后顺序都可以;只有当这个检查在入队时正好是红的,才需要先改规则再入队。
